segmentation.text: about to enter or exit a controlled-access highway
to all vehicles approaching on the highway
whose proximity constitutes an immediate hazard
and shall continue to yield the right-of-way
until the driver may proceed with reasonable safety.

elements.justification: 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate; 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.
As in NRS_484B_263_o1: st.controlled_access 'a highway with access only at designated points'; entry and exit read by drv.motion.entering_region and drv.motion.leaving_region over rel.occupies.
As in NRS_484B_263_o1: vehicles of the admitted aggregate occupying the controlled-access region and moving (drv.motion.moving).

'shall continue to yield the right-of-way ... until the driver may proceed': x holds back its entry or exit until it can be made with the safety margin; the entry or exit is the observation at which x proceeds.

'that traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, referring back to the vehicles approaching on the highway; each such vehicle is read as a member ('vehicles ... using any highway for purposes of travel').

operationalizations.convention: Safe merge headway (two-second rule, HCM freeway merge gap acceptance): at the entry or exit, every approaching vehicle of that traffic (prim.closest_approach_within over the critical-gap horizon) is at a surface gap from x (rel.surface_gap 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies') of at least its own speed (kin.speed) times p.merge_time_headway, so the margin grows with the approaching vehicle's speed.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and at this observation enters (drv.motion.entering_region x a) or leaves (drv.motion.leaving_region x a) a region a of kind st.controlled_access.
obligation: At this entry or exit, every vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, and a member of that traffic: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic) that occupies a (rel.occupies y a), is moving (drv.motion.moving y with p.speed_resolution) and approaches x (prim.closest_approach_within x y with horizon p.immediate_hazard_gap) is at a surface gap from x (rel_surface_gap x y) of at least kin_speed y times p.merge_time_headway.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
'about to enter or exit' is read by the entry into or exit from the controlled-access region.
Continuing to yield until the driver may proceed is read at the entry or exit observation: the manoeuvre is made only when the safety margin holds.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: x enters controlled-access region a at 15 m/s while vehicle y in a, moving at 30 m/s and approaching x, is at rel.surface_gap 20 m.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: x enters a as the only road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x drives on an arterial; no st.controlled_access region is entered or left.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but rel.surface_gap is not observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: x enters a while y, approaching at 30 m/s, is at rel.surface_gap 90 m.

param_proposals.name: p.speed_resolution
param_proposals.convention: Sensor resolution: the smallest speed the acquisition standard separates from standstill; a speed at or below it counts as no motion.
param_proposals.source: carla_scene_graph acquisition standard: speed resolution of the recorded kinematics

param_proposals.name: p.immediate_hazard_gap
param_proposals.convention: Critical gap: the time within which another road user's arrival at the conflict area, or its predicted closest approach, counts as an immediate hazard to a road user about to cross or join its path.
param_proposals.source: HCM 7th ed. Exhibit 20-11 base critical headway (major-street left turn)

param_proposals.name: p.merge_time_headway
param_proposals.convention: Safe merge headway: the time an approaching vehicle on the highway would take, at its own speed, to close the gap to a vehicle entering or leaving the highway; a smaller gap is not reasonable safety.
param_proposals.source: Two-second following rule; HCM freeway merge gap acceptance
